label: late original-phase input t in sequences starting with i
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.0007% of steps, ~97 sequences). Fires only in the original phase, mostly at orig_idx 6 (78% of mass), when the input token is t (93% of mass) and the first original token is i (89% of mass; often i a ... as the opening). Never fires in the delimiter or copy phase, or at positions 0-3. Rare weak activations on other letters (r, g, l) in the same context. The predicate captures ~80% of mass on dev but precision is only ~3%: most late t inputs in i-initial sequences do not fire. Activation seems to depend on a specific prefix context (inputs like a, f, p, 1, q, z earlier; requiring >=3 of these raises precision to ~29% but cuts recall), so the exact trigger is a narrow hidden-state conjunction that the variables do not capture well. Largest activations are at orig_idx 6 with t right after a 1 or f.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 18 cues. Raise it: orig0=i (+3.58), orig1=a (+2.16), prev_tok=1 (+1.72), t=6 & in_tok=t (+1.64), phase=0 & in_tok=t (+1.51), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=t (+1.51). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-1.73), orig_idx=-1 (-1.62), in_first=0 (-1.17), orig8=- (-0.83).
